info.title: Gani Platform API — planned
info.description: Paths NOT served yet (`x-status: planned`, `x-sprint`): the contract the front end builds on until each moves to openapi.json. Same rules as openapi.json: session cookie, organisation from the session, RFC 9457 errors with a snake_case `code`.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` is the stable word (Brief P9).

monthlyBudgetUsd.description: The budget of one calendar month in the time zone of the workspace (`workspace.timezone`), in USD. BudgetGuard warns at 80% and stops at 100% (`ai_budget_exceeded`, back to the scripted flow).

usedThisMonthUsd.description: Spent since the month began in `workspace.timezone` (ai_usage_logs).

resetsAt.description: When the next month begins in `workspace.timezone`, and the spending starts again at 0.

aiCostMonthVnd.description: null until the AI Gateway exists; Q1 still locks production (U65, CEO 05/11/2026).
